findings.title: Harvests on the To date are left out of stats (and of the dashboard's best plant on 31 Dec)
findings.expected: With From = To = 2026-09-30, the 150 g Lettuce harvest logged that day is counted (1 harvest, 150 g)
findings.actual: "0 harvests from 30 Sept 2026 to 30 Sept 2026" and "No harvests in this range"; the API returns harvest_count 0 because the query uses harvested_on < to

findings.title: Stats page crashes and stays on 'Loading stats…' with the old data when the stats response is malformed or empty
findings.expected: A visible error message and no uncaught errors when /api/stats/harvests returns an unexpected body
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"; the page shows "Loading stats…" next to the previous range's best plants, and no error
